title: Single-cell total RNA extraction from marine protists
author: Joost S Mansour
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bvhyn37w
materials: Samples need to have been acquired in 100 µL lysis buffer Contributed by users (from the RNAqueous™-Micro Total RNA Isolation Kit Thermo Fisher Catalog #AM1931 ). See our sampling protocol here: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bqvrmw56
Brief vortex and gentle/short spin down

steps.title: Prepare tubes and elution solution
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary tubes and pre-heat the elution solution.

substeps.instruction: Prepare and label two RNase-free tubes per sample: one for the total RNA extract and one for a Bioanalyzer aliquot.
Prepare 12.5 µL of Elution Solution (RNAqueous™-Micro Total RNA Isolation Kit, Thermo Fisher Catalog #AM1931) per sample in DNase/RNase-free 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes.
Place the Elution Solution in a 75 °C heat block.

steps.title: Sample preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the marine protist samples based on their type.

substeps.instruction: For Acantharia samples: thaw and vortex twice for 10 seconds each (ensure lids are secure).
For other sample types: thaw on ice.
Spin down gently.

steps.title: Initial RNA binding
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample for filtration and load onto the cartridge.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL of 100% Molecular grade ethanol to all samples.
Load the 150 µL samples onto separate Microfilter cartridges (use a 100 µL pipette twice).
Centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 10 seconds (maximum speed).

steps.title: Wash the RNA
steps.instruction: Perform sequential washes to purify the RNA on the filter.

substeps.instruction: Add 180 µL of Wash Solution 1 to the Microfilter cartridge and centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 30 seconds (maximum speed).
Add 180 µL of Wash Solution 2/3 to the Microfilter cartridge and centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 30 seconds (maximum speed).
Repeat the addition of 180 µL of Wash Solution 2/3 and centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 30 seconds (maximum speed).

steps.title: Dry the filter
steps.instruction: Remove all residual wash solutions from the filter.

substeps.instruction: Remove and discard all flow-through by pouring it out of the collection/elution tube.
Centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 1 minute (maximum speed) to remove any remaining liquid on the filter.

steps.title: Elute total RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the RNA from the filter using pre-heated solution.

substeps.instruction: Replace the collection/elution tube with a clean new one, keeping the filter assembly.
Add 6.5 µL of Elution Solution (pre-heated at 75 °C) directly to the center of the filter.
Incubate at room temperature for 1 minute.
Centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 30 seconds (maximum speed).
Add an additional 6.0 µL of Elution Solution (pre-heated at 75 °C) directly to the center of the filter.
Incubate at room temperature for 1 minute.
Centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 30 seconds (maximum speed).

steps.title: Store and quantify RNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the RNA and perform quality assessment.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the 12.5 µL of RNA from the elution tube to labeled 0.2 mL RNase-free PCR tubes (8-strip format, Thermo Fisher Catalog #AM12230) using a 100 µL pipette.
Take a 1.5 µL aliquot for the Bioanalyzer in a separate labeled tube, keeping it on ice.
Store RNA at -80 °C.
Quantify and assess RNA quality using a Bioanalyzer following the Agilent RNA 6000 Pico Kit manufacturer's protocol.
